Dubai Marina remains one of Dubai’s most liquid waterfront markets: marina walk, metro/tram access, and strong demand for both ready apartments and long-term rentals.

FAQ · Marina Gate 2

Short answers for search / AI overviews. Expand for detail.

What is Marina Gate 2?

Marina Gate 2 is a ready residential tower in Dubai Marina with about 61 floors and 519 units, operated/branded with Select Group. Right now Refty shows 51 active for-sale and 103 for-rent listings (sale median ~3.48M AED), rent median ~165,000 AED/year.

How many apartments are for sale in Marina Gate 2 right now?

Refty currently lists 51 active for-sale units in Marina Gate 2, with a median asking price around 3.48M AED. Counts change as permits expire or new ads appear.

Is Marina Gate 2 good for renting?

There are 103 active for-rent listings (median ~165,000 AED/year). Location near Marina Walk and transport supports tenant demand; always check PvM and unit photos for real views.

Who is the developer of Marina Gate 2?

DLD records often show the master developer legal entity; the residential brand commonly associated with Marina Gate residences is Select Group. Confirm unit title documents before purchase.

How should I use PvM on this page?

PvM (price vs market) shows how far the asking price sits from comparable inventory. Roughly: at/below market is often worth a call; PvM above +5% is flagged as overpriced on this desk.
